title: Wish it was softer
text: Wish it was softer. This is certainly a beautiful throw however the sherpa on the inside was rough and the fleece was not soft like I expected.  A perfect throw for "show" but not as comfortable as many I have purchased at a lower price.

product_metadata.title: Eddie Bauer Home Brushed Throw Blanket Reversible Sherpa & Brushed Fleece, Lightweight Decor for Bed or Couch, Nordic Raisin
features: MATERIAL: Made with ultra-soft polar fleece, with a premium faux shearling popcorn fleece reverse- Super soft and cozy

FEATURES: Faux shearling trim and signature Eddie Bauer logo label complete the look; Throw blanket is wonderfully soft and warm as a go-to throw or for the foot of your bed; Choose between Eddie's many pattern and style options; Lightweight and easily packable
CARE: Machine wash cold, tumble dry low- EASY CARE
description: The Eddie Bauer nordic plaid collection is timeless. One of Eddie's best-sellers, the nordic throw features a classic plaid print and reverses to a solid ivory popcorn fleece. This throw is reversible for multiple uses. Features a faux-shearling trim as well as the signature Eddie Bauer logo patch detailing. Packaged in a ribbon with insert card, ready to be gifted. This throw is generously sized at 50"x70". Easy care and easily packable, making it an ideal companion for travel. Available in multiple colors, sold separately.
